name: Idea research — charts to research memo

nodes.label: Frame my idea
nodes.instructions:
Read my brief and selected charts or documents. Describe the visible observations and identify unclear dates, axes or units. Treat precise values as unknown unless a source supplies them.

Use web and market search when a ticker, price or time-sensitive claim matters. Give the source, currency and market timestamp for any quoted price. If reported annual financials would help choose a direction, use sec_lookup for the relevant US issuer and metric. The filing receipt arrives after this answer. Leave values pending until it arrives.

Propose two or three distinct, testable ideas. For each, give the mechanism, the strongest alternative explanation, what would falsify it and a useful next test. Recommend a lead for me to review and flag the gaps that could change the choice.

Use short Markdown sections in conclusion and leave hypotheses empty.

nodes.label: Choose research direction
nodes.instructions: Read Frame my idea and inspect its web sources and SEC filing receipt when present. Choose the idea to pursue. In your feedback, record what you disagree with, the ticker or metric to check when relevant, and what evidence would change your mind. Approve to continue or reject to stop and revise.

nodes.label: Research support and objections
nodes.instructions:
Follow the idea and constraints in my review feedback. Treat the framing output, its tool receipts and selected evidence as research leads. Verify material claims with dated primary sources, and search independently for contrary evidence. Compare mechanisms, history and confounders. Cite each material web claim with its source URL and date.

Use market search for current quotes and include currency and market timestamp. Choose one annual SEC ticker and metric through sec_lookup when needed to calculate a filing comparison for the approved idea. If annual filings are irrelevant, return null. The worker attaches the lookup to this step for the calculation and memo.

Document the evidence for and against the idea, remaining gaps, and the next quantitative test with its required data. Add two or three related ideas if supported by the research. Give each its own falsifier. Use short Markdown sections in conclusion (up to 6000 characters) and leave hypotheses empty.

nodes.label: Calculate a simple model
nodes.instructions: Compares the two latest annual SEC periods retrieved by Research support and objections. Reports the values, absolute change and percentage change when the prior value is positive. A research-data block in the brief takes precedence and runs the editable OLS model.

nodes.label: Draft the research memo
nodes.instructions:
Draft a concise Markdown research memo for the direction I approved. Lead with the idea, mechanism and what the evidence can establish. Cover contrary evidence, falsifiers, related ideas and the next test. Use the recorded URLs and dates in the research packet; distinguish market timestamps from search observation time, and label estimates and inferences.

For filing_change, report the exact values and absolute change, plus percentage change if present. Specify the fiscal periods, units, filing dates and forms from the SEC observations. Link the SEC concept URL. For computed OLS results, report the actual values, sample size, data source and basis, assumptions and limitations. Label extrapolation. For needs_data, explain the missing input and propose a test. Use any unavailable SEC receipt to describe the specific gap.

Keep my feedback and unresolved disagreement visible. Leave hypotheses empty and put the memo in conclusion (up to 6000 characters).

nodes.label: Review the idea and analysis
nodes.instructions: Read the memo alongside the earlier step outputs and the calculation event. Verify the cited evidence, dates and units, and judge the idea, counterevidence and next test. Approve to finish or reject to stop. To incorporate feedback from this review, iterate from the run and start a new version.

nodes.label: Finish
nodes.instructions: Research draft ready for owner judgment.
